{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
sales.head()

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue column
print("Unique values in revenue (first 10):", sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for QA orders
print("Rows with revenue = 999999.99:", sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0])

# Check status
print("Unique values in status:", sales['status'].unique())

# Check if channel is randomised
print("Channel distribution:", sales['channel'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment
print("Customer segment distribution:", sales['customer_segment'].value_counts())"}
